_doc: Shard-ready step 5. "run": suites that must be green with E2E_TWO_DB=all (every shard on a second database, cross-family FKs dropped). "knownLimitations": suites that pass on one database but cannot pass on two yet; they are NOT failures, they are the to-do list of plan steps 6-8. "environmentOnly": fail on one database too when the local .env lacks Stripe / DB roles / MailHog; unrelated to sharding.
